title: Notebook opens and repeated illegal attempts preserve chess state
description:
Notebook opens and repeated illegal attempts preserve chess state

1. ACTION: Open the configured local tunnel root / in an isolated browser context; no login and no game-state injection. Wait up to 15 seconds for #paperwild-loading to disappear and for 64 #board-access .square-hit controls. Use actual UI controls and square data-testid values square-e2 etc, whose data-piece values are wp/bp/wq etc. Between moves wait #game-status[data-moving=false][data-thinking=false]; allow 15 seconds. On compact layouts open Field kit #field-options to reach hidden mode/study controls, then close dialogs before board actions. Studies preselect their source: click the destination directly. Assert actual state before performing the next action. Do not invent viewport tools or use unsupported browser-resize actions. A service pass must have concrete UI assertions. Select With a friend [data-mode=local]. Begin a new game and confirm Begin again if a saved game exists. Close any Field kit dialog. Select e2 and click e5 three times.

2. ASSERTION: e2 remains wp and e5 remains empty; #game-status data-turn=w; #field-capture-count is 00 and Journal is empty. An invalid/refusal hint appears, but no move is committed.

3. ACTION: Click e4 directly, since e2 remains selected. Wait settled.

4. ASSERTION: e2 is empty and e4 is wp; turn=b; Journal has exactly one SAN e4; capture count remains00 and no finale or stale refusal overlay remains after settling.

title: Named capture produces a remembrance card and Undo restores both residents
description:
Named capture produces a remembrance card and Undo restores both residents

1. ACTION: Open the configured local tunnel root / in an isolated browser context; no login and no game-state injection. Wait up to 15 seconds for #paperwild-loading to disappear and for 64 #board-access .square-hit controls. Use actual UI controls and square data-testid values square-e2 etc, whose data-piece values are wp/bp/wq etc. Between moves wait #game-status[data-moving=false][data-thinking=false]; allow 15 seconds. On compact layouts open Field kit #field-options to reach hidden mode/study controls, then close dialogs before board actions. Studies preselect their source: click the destination directly. Assert actual state before performing the next action. Do not invent viewport tools or use unsupported browser-resize actions. A service pass must have concrete UI assertions. Start a fresh full game in With a friend mode. Play e2-e4, d7-d5, e4-d5, waiting after every move. Wait for capture move to settle.

2. ASSERTION: e4 is empty and d5 is wp; turn=b; capture count01; 31 direct .sketch-cast>.sketch-piece residents. The captured original d7 pawn is Tuck, taken by the original e2 pawn Rowan.

3. ACTION: Open Journal #field-notes then #journal-remembrance.

4. ASSERTION: #remembrance-dialog is open; exactly one .remembrance-card; card contains Tuck, Rowan, d5, move2 and Indigo. #remembrance-save is enabled.

5. ACTION: Close remembrance using Close the garden of remembrance; click Undo last turn and wait settled.

6. ASSERTION: e4=wp,d5=bp; turn=w; capture count00;32 direct board residents. Open Journal then remembrance again: no .remembrance-card and #remembrance-save disabled.

title: Radio tuning and mute controls retain their state across reload
description:
Radio tuning and mute controls retain their state across reload

1. ACTION: Open the configured local tunnel root / in an isolated browser context; no login and no game-state injection. Wait up to 15 seconds for #paperwild-loading to disappear and for 64 #board-access .square-hit controls. Use actual UI controls and square data-testid values square-e2 etc, whose data-piece values are wp/bp/wq etc. Between moves wait #game-status[data-moving=false][data-thinking=false]; allow 15 seconds. On compact layouts open Field kit #field-options to reach hidden mode/study controls, then close dialogs before board actions. Studies preselect their source: click the destination directly. Assert actual state before performing the next action. Do not invent viewport tools or use unsupported browser-resize actions. A service pass must have concrete UI assertions. Visit Radio Small Hours [data-camp=radio]. Click its .camp-radio-toggle to tune in; this is a real gesture and also enables sound.

2. ASSERTION: #sound aria-pressed=true. .camp-radio-toggle aria-pressed=true; it offers tuning out. This verifies UI scheduling state, not subjective audibility.

3. ACTION: Click #sound to mute.

4. ASSERTION: #sound aria-pressed=false; station remains selected and tuned-in but its UI indicates muted. No console error.

5. ACTION: Reload; wait for notebook to disappear; visit Radio Small Hours if necessary.

6. ASSERTION: #sound remains aria-pressed=false, radio preference remains tuned-in, and the station does not falsely indicate audible on-air playback.
